name: IntAct molecular interaction database
scope: Curated molecular interactions from the literature and direct submissions in PSI-MI formats; the release directory holds all.zip (15 GB), the psi25 and psi30 directories, a psimitab directory, controlled vocabularies (cv) and various tables. Open Targets integrates IntAct, Signor, Reactome and STRING interactions: its 26.09 interaction dataset holds 1,310,951 IntAct rows, 594,648 distinct gene pairs.
mapping_methods: Interactions name both participants by UniProt accession with the detection method, interaction type and publication.

quantitative.summary: Presence of an interaction with its detection method; a confidence score exists but its definition was not read.

licence.name: EMBL-EBI terms of use, as listed for IntAct in the Open Targets data-source licence table; the IntAct-specific licence statement was not retrieved.

update_frequency: Several releases a year (the directory is dated 2026-01-14).
coverage_limitations: Interactions are curated from what has been studied
Participants are whole proteins; the effect of a variant on an interaction is recorded only in the mutation annotations that were not examined
known_omissions: All files: the human interactions reach the library through the Open Targets interaction dataset; the 15 GB archive, the PSI-MI files and mutation annotations are not fetched

reuse_decision.rationale: Already integrated in Open Targets (594,648 distinct human gene pairs), so a separate 15 GB archive adds mostly the same pairs. Revisit when interaction-level mutation annotations are needed.

unverified_fields: quantitative (the definition of the confidence score was not read)

evidence_profile.biological_context: Interactions curated from publications with the detection method of each; they are properties of whole proteins in the studied system.
evidence_profile.evidence_strength: Literature curation with an interaction confidence score; independent detections raise the score.
evidence_profile.mechanistic_confidence: Low for variant effects: an interaction says two proteins associate, not that a particular change disrupts it.
evidence_profile.absence_means: A pair that is not listed was not reported in curated publications; it is not shown not to interact.

overlaps_with_sources.note: Open Targets carries IntAct interactions as its intact source; use one route and count each pair once
separate curation of physical interactions; two thirds of the curated Open Targets pairs (IntAct, Signor, Reactome) also appear in BioGRID
